tools.name: get_committee_trading
tools.description: For a given congressional committee, returns which members have stock trades in CTA's records for the last N days, their trade counts, and the percentage of the committee with at least one recorded trade.

tools.name: get_member_trades
tools.description: Returns stock trades disclosed by one member of Congress, newest trade first, with optional ticker and date-window filters. member_name must exactly match the member name as stored: the STOCK Act filer name with honorifics removed, which is often a legal name rather than the name the member is commo

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Returns the members of Congress with the most trades in CTA's records, by trade count, optionally filtered by chamber (House or Senate) and date window.

tools.name: get_trade_feed
tools.description: Get recently disclosed congressional stock trades from CTA's records, with optional filters for politician, ticker, party, chamber, and transaction type.

tools.name: get_member_profile
tools.description: Returns a trading profile for one member of Congress from CTA's records: trade count, buys and sells, first and last trade dates, average disclosure lag, party, chamber, state, and committee assignments. member_name must exactly match the stored member name (the STOCK Act filer name with honorifics

tools.name: get_trades_by_ticker
tools.description: Get the congressional trades in CTA's records for a specific stock ticker symbol, newest first.

tools.name: get_ticker_buyers
tools.description: Get the members of Congress with a recorded purchase of a specific ticker in CTA's records for the last N days, aggregated per politician.

tools.name: get_top_tickers
tools.description: Get the tickers with the most congressional trades in CTA's records for the last N days. Set tx_type='Purchase' for most-bought tickers, or tx_type='Sale' for most-sold. Omit tx_type to rank purchases and sales together (default).

tools.name: get_party_breakdown
tools.description: Get counts of the trades in CTA's records broken down by party (D/R/I), with optional date filter.

tools.name: get_chamber_breakdown
tools.description: Get counts of the trades in CTA's records broken down by chamber (House vs Senate), with optional date filter. Senate counts since October 23, 2026 are partial (see the server instructions).

tools.name: get_aggregate_stats
tools.description: Get high-level stats on CTA's records: trades recorded (since records began + 30/60/90d), members with recorded trades, avg filing delay, sector breakdown.

tools.name: search_members_and_tickers
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search over member names, ticker symbols, and company names. Returns up to `limit` matching members and up to `limit` matching tickers, each ordered by trade count. Use it to turn a common or partial name into the exact stored name that get_member_trades and get_member_pro
